question: Should OpenClaw support this as a first-class compaction quality gate, and if so, which existing compaction test or evaluation surface should own the executable integration?
rationale: The branch creates a new project-level QA command but does not connect it to runtime compaction; selecting the durable owner and intended gating behavior is a maintainer test-strategy decision.

options.title: Integrate with live compaction tests
options.body: Move the scenarios into the current compaction safeguard/evaluation surface and assert against summaries generated by that implementation.

options.title: Keep it as an offline fixture tool
options.body: Accept a clearly documented developer-only checker, without presenting its pass rate as evidence of runtime compaction quality.

options.title: Decline the new test surface
options.body: Close or narrow the contribution if existing compaction tests are the preferred single source of regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Integrate with live compaction tests
recommendation.body: Move the scenarios into the current compaction safeguard/evaluation surface and assert against summaries generated by that implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the only concrete human review direction in the available PR history and can route the required current-main refresh.
